title: Only self care that works
body: This is genuinely the only self care app that has worked for me. No other app ive tried has had me logging my moods, feelings, and tasks daily for years (and yes years i have almost a 400 day streak). As someone who struggles to do consistent tasks like logging in daily and etc., this app makes it SO easy and so encouraging to do things. I dont know what it is but out of every single app ive tried this has genuinely been the best!
author: Mxdnight111

title: Ask for Help From Moderators & Didn’t Get Any.
body:
Hi, this app charged my card $30USD for a subscription and when I asked for help in their discord server I saw that my account had been flagged as being under 13. I contacted a moderator & they were able to help me a little in contacting even more moderators. Anyways, as I’m talking to them they told me they can’t help me get into the discord server because on the verification google form that they have my birthday is marked as March 2010. That’s not my birthday. My birthday is Dec 2004. 

I didn’t want to join the discord server to make friends but rather to ask for help for this purchase I did not approve. I thought maybe asking would speed up the process of getting my money back but no! They told me to come back at the end of the month so that they can remove the role that is blocking me from talking in the discord server. I even offered to send picture proof of my ID so that they can verify my age but they completely ignored that & told me they couldn’t help me. Again, I seriously don’t care about joining the server & I’m perfectly fine with a free Finch but this just ridiculous, extremely frustrating & also very unprofessional.

I’m not financially stable & that $30 USD is a lot for me to lose. Please if ANYONE of the devs see this & can help me I’d greatly appreciate it.
